subs.note: Tomás Luis de Victoria. The movements of the mass, each on its own.

items.title: Kyrie (Victoria, Missa O quam gloriosam)
items.desc: Tomás Luis de Victoria, Missa O quam gloriosam, Kyrie. 4 voices (Cantus, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Note values as in the edition (whole note = semibreve), at the original pitch; editorial accidentals small above the staff.
